topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The flowers arrived, filling the room with a silent, blooming presence. Each petal seemed to carry a whisper, a soft murmur that floated through the air. No note, no words to anchor them to a moment or a person, yet they stood there, complete in their own silent language. I traced the curve of a leaf, feeling the texture of its life, its journey from soil to bloom. It’s peculiar how things find their way to you, unbidden, like whispered secrets or unexpected visits from the sky. The flowers, in their unmarked vase, spoke of moments shared and hidden truths, of the gentle intricacies of being that don’t need explaining. I found myself smiling, a quiet thank you to the unseen, the unspoken.
